fields.Name: Skip ICF - Event Revenue and Registrations
fields.Description: Events-category products ranked by 2025 confirmed revenue with registration counts, drill to registrants. Ported from "Events Ranked by Revenue".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me all of our event products ranked by total confirmed revenue in 2025, with the number of registrations for each. Display as a table. Let me click on an event product to see who registered. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a table of event products ranked by 2025 revenue
Uses the Orders domain (Order Lines joined to Products in the Events category) with confirmed sales orders
Workshop Registration (about $214K, about 1,469 lines) ranks above Conference Registration (about $176K, about 402 lines), with Competition entry far behind
Revenue is formatted as currency and sorted descending
Clicking a product shows the registrants (person name, order date, amount, ticket tier where available)
Rows can open the underlying person or order record
